python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0018.png"))
# Cabinet: xs around 220 to 450, ys around 300 to 410
mask_cab = (img[:, :, 0] > 180) & (img[:, :, 1] > 180) & (img[:, :, 2] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 450) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] < 350)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_cab)
print(f"Cabinet top in 18: xs=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], ys=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], cx={xs.mean():.1f}")

# Cabinet ground contact: bottom of front panel
mask_panel = (img[:, :, 0] > 180) & (img[:, :, 1] > 150) & (img[:, :, 2] > 120) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 280) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 450)
ys_p, xs_p = np.where(mask_panel)
print(f"Cabinet panel: xs=[{xs_p.min()}, {xs_p.max()}], ys=[{ys_p.min()}, {ys_p.max()}], bottom={ys_p.max()}, cx={xs_p.mean():.1f}")
'
